protocol.role: post-outcome development fixed-state mechanism screen on consumed states; not independent confirmation
protocol.roster_validation: exact compact projection of all 5,003 source diagnostic states; the four motivating regressions receive no special filtering or weight

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

registered_state_schema.support_reference_score: registered legacy K120 maximum one-frame support
registered_state_schema.legacy_first_exact_score_attempt: first legacy-search paid attempt attaining registered support

rule.residual_bound_role: safe pruning and final certificate only; never heap priority or tie-break
rule.price_vectors: all lambda_c in {0, Q_c}; 2^3=8 fixed masks
rule.threshold_cap: min(v4 weighted cap, v4 coordinate cap, min_lambda[lambda dot residual + suffix reduced max + (remaining-1) global reduced max])
rule.equality_rule: a residual upper bound equal to the incumbent is retained whenever the unchanged v4 generation gate retains it
rule.lazy_pruning: an already queued prefix is removed without a paid attempt when its residual upper bound becomes strictly below the incumbent
rule.candidate_attempt: idle, nine homogeneous seeds, and each surviving popped option choice; pruned prefixes are free
rule.certificate: max(incumbent, maximum residual upper bound across every surviving frontier entry)
rule.unchanged: homogeneous seeds, v4 option order, stable serial allocation point, feasibility, consider tie break, duration thresholds and search tree
rule.admissibility: weak duality for every nonnegative price vector; the zero mask reproduces the v4 weighted cap

execution_invariants.same_budget_support: sidecar K26 score is pointwise at least registered legacy K26
execution_invariants.same_budget_certificate: sidecar K26 upper bound is pointwise no larger than registered legacy K26
execution_invariants.same_budget_gap: sidecar K26 gap is pointwise no larger than registered legacy K26
execution_invariants.exact_checkpoint: sidecar K120 is exact and matches registered legacy K120 support
execution_invariants.trace: one continuous K26-to-K120 trace matches independent K26 and K120 selector calls
execution_invariants.work: all prefix, attempt, bound-mask and frontier accounting identities close

advance_gate.execution: all execution invariants and all source reconstruction checks pass
advance_gate.primary: at every K26-policy load, mean support regret, strict loss count, mean certified gap and mean candidate attempts are no worse, while exact-support and exact-certified fractions are no worse
advance_gate.sensitivity_veto: the same six nonworsening checks hold at every K120-policy load
advance_gate.advance: primary exposure contains safe pruning and at least one primary load strictly improves a support metric
advance_gate.certificate_or_work_only: all guardrails pass, no support metric strictly improves, and a certificate or candidate-attempt metric strictly improves

work_accounting.candidate_attempts: paid candidate construction only; safe pruning is uncharged
work_accounting.legacy_bound: one v4 suffix table and one old upper bound per generated prefix
work_accounting.dual_bound: eight price masks, mask tables, eligible-threshold evaluations and residual mask sums
work_accounting.frontier: virtual serial allocations, pushes, generation prunes, lazy pop prunes, paid pops, exact-stop clears and final certificate entries
work_accounting.certificate_scan: one side-effect-free full-frontier scan per returned checkpoint
work_accounting.runtime_interpretation: fewer paid attempts do not imply lower wall time because the sidecar adds dual-bound work

protocol.stopping_rule: evaluate this fixed sidecar once on all reused states; execution failure requires a newly registered corrected version; support improvement under all guardrails advances to separately preregistered full development trajectories; certificate-or-work-only benefit stops here; every other valid outcome closes the sidecar without tuning masks, budgets or states
protocol.prohibited_in_this_stage: arrival generation, trajectory simulation, policy feedback, new seeds, new states, mask or budget variants, confirmation claims and paper edits
protocol.support_reference: registered legacy K120 score only; exact means maximum one-frame support and does not define a physical tie or flow oracle

next_step: preregister full development trajectories for the frozen legacy-priority residual-capacity sidecar
limitations: The state roster and the rule choice both use consumed development evidence; this is a mechanism screen, not independent confirmation.
The sidecar preserves v4 heap priority and can skip prefixes only after the fixed residual bound proves they are strictly below the incumbent.
The eight binary prices are a fixed Lagrangian relaxation and need not attain the tightest continuous dual bound.
Candidate attempts exclude the added dual-bound work, so fewer attempts do not establish lower runtime.
K120 certifies maximum one-frame support only. It neither defines a unique physical tie action nor predicts mean flow or P90.
Legacy visited time is an exposure weight from the source policy and is not the duration of a counterfactual variant trajectory.
